description: An isometric core and triceps support hold performed between two sturdy chairs or benches.
setup: Sit between two chairs or parallel benches with hands resting flat on the edges and shoulders pressed down.
steps: Depress your shoulders and push down hard through your palms to lift your hips off the seat.
Pull your knees tightly up into your chest with toes pointed.
Keep arms locked straight and chest elevated proudly.
Breathe steadily and hold the tucked hover motionless.
cues: Push the chair seats down into the floor to keep shoulders away from ears
Compress knees as close to your chest as possible

mistakes.mistake: Shrugging shoulders into ears with bent elbows
mistakes.fix: Lock elbows completely straight and actively push shoulders down

mistakes.mistake: Letting feet or knees sag toward the floor
mistakes.fix: Engage hip flexors and lower abs to keep knees tightly tucked high

rep_standard: Timer runs while body is completely supported on palms with arms straight, hips suspended in air, and knees tucked into chest.
